verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers general building blocks that could be adapted for board consents: a no-code builder for creating documents from templates, Workflow Designer workflows with approval policies, and online signing. Nothing in the evidence mentions board consents, resolutions, director approvals or governance-specific templates, so this support is only implied by its generic contract tooling. Missing for 10: board consent/resolution templates, director/board approval or unanimous-written-consent routing, governance-specific record keeping, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of this use case.
